# TP-Link Canada
> TP-Link Canada provides consumer and business networking equipment, smart home devices, and support resources for WiFi, mesh, routing, and connectivity products.

TP-Link is a global networking brand offering home and business WiFi solutions, mesh systems, routers, switches, smart home products, and product support. This index emphasizes Canadian product, technology, and support pages that are useful for technical discovery and assistance.

## Core Technology
- [WiFi 7](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/wifi7/): Overview of TP-Link WiFi 7 products, capabilities, and next-generation wireless performance.
- [WiFi 6](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/wifi6/): Introduction to WiFi 6 products and benefits for faster, more efficient networking.
- [HomeCare](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/homecare/): Security, parental controls, and QoS platform for supported TP-Link home devices.
- [OneMesh](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/onemesh/): Mesh networking technology for extending seamless WiFi across compatible TP-Link devices.
- [Gaming Technology](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/technology/gaming/): Gaming-focused networking products and features for low-latency home connectivity.

## Mesh Wi-Fi Systems
- [Deco Mesh Wi-Fi](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/): Main category for TP-Link Deco whole-home mesh WiFi systems.
- [Wi-Fi 7 Mesh](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/?filterby=6271): Deco mesh systems filtered for WiFi 7 models.
- [Wi-Fi 6/6E Mesh](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/?filterby=6093%7C5730): Deco mesh systems filtered for WiFi 6E and WiFi 6 models.
- [Wi-Fi 5 Mesh](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/?filterby=4809): Deco mesh systems filtered for WiFi 5 models.
- [Outdoor Mesh](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/?filterby=6524): Deco mesh systems designed for outdoor wireless coverage.
- [Ceiling-Mount Mesh](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/?filterby=6525): Deco mesh systems intended for ceiling-mounted deployments.

- [Gaming Routers](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/technology/gaming/): Gaming-oriented routers and related networking technology pages.

## Home Networking Categories
- [Deco](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/): Whole-home mesh WiFi systems for seamless residential coverage.
- [Routers](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/wifi-router/): Standalone wireless routers for home networking deployments.
- [Mesh Wi-Fi](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/home-networking/deco/): Entry point for mesh WiFi products and filtered model browsing.
- [WiFi 7](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/wifi7/): Product and technology hub for TP-Link WiFi 7 networking devices.
- [Upgrade to WiFi 6](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/wifi6/): Product and technology hub for WiFi 6 upgrades.

## Support
- [Setup Videos](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/support/setup-video/): Video tutorials for installing and configuring TP-Link products.
- [Support Home](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/support/): Central support portal for downloads, FAQs, and troubleshooting resources.
- [Download Center](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/support/download/): Firmware, drivers, utilities, and manuals for TP-Link products.
- [FAQ](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/support/faq/): Knowledge base articles covering setup, troubleshooting, and product usage.
- [Warranty](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/support/replacement-warranty/): Warranty and replacement policy information for TP-Link products.
- [Technical Support Contact](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/support/contact-technical-support/): Contact options for obtaining direct technical assistance.

## Business and Enterprise
- [Business Networking](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/business-networking/): Overview of TP-Link networking products for business environments.
- [Omada](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/business-networking/omada/): Software-defined networking platform for centralized business WiFi and switching.
- [Access Points](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/business-networking/omada-access-point/): Business wireless access points for managed indoor and outdoor deployments.
- [Switches](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/business-networking/omada-switch/): Managed and smart switches for business network infrastructure.
- [Routers](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/business-networking/omada-router/): Business gateways and routers for secure network edge connectivity.
- [Controllers](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/business-networking/omada-controller/): Centralized management controllers for Omada network deployments.

## Smart Home
- [Smart Home](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/smart-home/): Main hub for TP-Link smart home products and categories.
- [Tapo](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/smart-home/tapo/): Smart home product line including cameras, plugs, lighting, and sensors.
- [Kasa Smart](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/smart-home/kasa/): Smart home devices for automation, lighting, and connected control.
- [Smart Cameras](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/smart-home/camera/): Indoor and outdoor smart cameras for home monitoring.
- [Smart Plugs](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/smart-home/smart-plug/): Connected plugs for remote control and automation.
- [Smart Lighting](https://www.tp-link.com/ca/smart-home/smart-bulb/): Smart bulbs and lighting products for app-based home control.
